INSERT INTO credit_accounts (account_id, available_htc)
           VALUES ($1, $2)
           ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE
             SET available_htc = credit_accounts.available_htc + $2,
                 escrowed_htc  = GREATEST(0, credit_accounts.escrowed_htc - $2),
                 updated_at    = now()
